biotools.summary: BIT is a Bayesian hierarchical model for in-silico identification of transcriptional regulators (TRs) leveraging ChIP-seq data to assess consistency between user-provided epigenomic profiling data and a TR binding library. It offers a fully integrated Bayesian approach to quantify uncertainty and identifies perturbed TRs in perturbation experiments.
